profile_text.body:
The website harvested for this profile is dexus.com, and its content describes Dexus, an Australasian real estate and infrastructure fund manager. Dexus describes itself as having four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and as managing a multi-billion dollar portfolio. The site cites Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching its full height of more than 180 metres, and a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. It identifies Dexus as ASX: DXS and carries a standard disclaimer that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The company record, by contrast, identifies DXC Technology Co as a for-profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with CIK 0001688568. No products are tracked for it, no MCP servers are listed, and no individual lawsuits are recorded. The record shows a law exposure count of 152 in Virginia.

The site text and the company record do not describe the same business: the harvested pages cover Dexus and its funds, while the held facts name DXC Technology Co. No AI products appear in either the site material or the record.
